newsitem.title: USA: Arthur J. Gallagher, American Re in Canada venture.
newsitem.headline: Arthur J. Gallagher, American Re in Canada venture.

text.p: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co and American Re said Tuesday they formed a new jointly owned company in Canada.
Risk Management Products Canada offers customized insurance and risk management services for workers' compensation exposure in the Province of Ontario, they said.

Insurance and reinsurance will be underwritten by American Re. Risk management services, such as claims management, loss control and information management, will be provided by Gallagher Bassett Adjustors Canada.
Arthur J. Gallagher is an international insurance brokerage and risk management services firm. American Re, a member of the Munich Re Group, offers reinsurance and related services.
